other.name: Return large toys from kids room table or floor to toy bin

objects.name: Toys
objects.role: Items to be picked up and placed into the bin

starting_state.fact: Toys are randomly scattered on the floor and/or table.
starting_state.quote: Position: Randomly scattered on the floor and/or table.

steps.text: Walk to the toys and stand still for 1 second.
steps.quote: 1. Walk to the toys and stand still for 1 second.

steps.text: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1 large toy with both hands, or gather 2–3 small items (e.g., blocks) in one cupped hand.
steps.quote: 2. Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1 large toy with both hands, or gather 2–3 small items (e.g., blocks) in one cupped hand.

steps.text: Walk to the bin and stop for 1 second.
steps.quote: 3. Walk to the bin and stop for 1 second.

steps.text: Hold the item(s) directly over the bin opening and place into the bin.
steps.quote: 4. Hold the item(s) directly over the bin opening and place into the bin.

steps.text: Repeat until the floor is clear.
steps.quote: 5. Repeat until the floor is clear.

repeat.quote: Repeat until the floor is clear.

acceptance.criterion: The item(s) are placed inside the bin.

constraints.rule: No small parts or items requiring fine manipulation are permitted.
constraints.violation_looks_like: The person manipulates tiny toy components or items requiring delicate, fine-motor handling.
constraints.quote: Prohibited Objects: No small parts or items requiring fine manipulation.

constraints.rule: Do not throw toys into bin.
constraints.violation_looks_like: A toy is tossed, dropped from a distance, or thrown through the air toward or into the bin.
constraints.quote: Do not throw toys into bin.

constraints.violation_looks_like: Toys are piled above the rim of the bin causing items to spill or overflow.

not_modelled.reason: Instruction about resetting the scene between recording episodes.
Instruction on dataset diversity across recordings.
not_modelled.quote: Diversity: Vary toy types (blocks, cars, dolls, plushies). Change positions (floor vs. table). Vary number of items (3–6). Change bin location.
